additional_info.subject: RE: ID0462658-DC/Si-D/QA-[MP / S1 170003281] Firmware Upgrade & RFID Activation Request CRM:02681001112
additional_info.body:
Dear Joseph,
Please validate the mobile data available for the Siemens router XF3. I have updated to v4.0.11 but yesterday when I rollout the FW to v5 the charger got offline from SCB.
I'm assuming that the SIM has no more data available and the charger is offline because of that. I can't proceed with the updates.
Regarding the RFID activation I didn't fully understood the request. The RFID is activated for the outlets but to register the RFID Tag you need to request to customer backend. From our side we have no control to add RFID Tags.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
